subject: general
question: The analysis of variance technique was introduced by:
solution:
The correct answer is** RA Fisher**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **RA Fisher:**

 
 
• Sir Ronald Aylmer Fisher was a pioneering statistician and geneticist who introduced the analysis of variance (ANOVA) technique.
 
• ANOVA is a statistical method used to analyze the differences among group means in a sample. It is particularly useful in finance for comparing different investment portfolios or financial models.
 
• In a financial enterprise, ANOVA can help in assessing the performance of various financial assets, understanding market trends, and making informed investment decisions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolmogorov:**

 
 
• Andrey Kolmogorov was a Russian mathematician who made significant contributions to the fields of probability theory and topology, not specifically to ANOVA.
 
• His work is fundamental in understanding stochastic processes, which are essential in financial modeling and risk assessment.
 
 
 
• **CR Rao:**
 
 
• Calyampudi Radhakrishna Rao is a renowned Indian-American statistician known for his contributions to statistical theory, including the Cramer-Rao bound and Rao-Blackwell theorem.
 
• Although influential in statistics, he did not introduce ANOVA.
 
 
 
• **PC Mahalanobis:**
 
 
• Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis was an Indian statistician best known for developing the Mahalanobis distance, a measure of the distance between a point and a distribution.
 
• His work is vital in multivariate analysis and can be applied in financial risk assessment but not in the introduction of ANOVA.
